name: Hoan Kiem Lake
desc: The turtle-legend lake at the city's heart. One free lap at midnight fixes most moods.

name: Old Quarter
desc: Thirty-six ancient streets, each named for what it once sold. Wandering them IS the attraction.

name: Hanoi Train Street
desc: A real train squeezes past café stools a few times a day. Cheap coffee, front-row adrenaline.

name: Temple of Literature
desc: Vietnam's thousand-year-old first university. A few bucks to walk where scholars once sweated their exams.

name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
desc: Solemn granite, silent guards, free entry. Dress like you're meeting someone's strict grandfather.

name: Tran Quoc Pagoda
desc: A 1,500-year-old red pagoda floating on West Lake. Sunset here is free and criminally photogenic.

name: Hoa Lo Prison Museum
desc: The infamous 'Hanoi Hilton.' Sobering history for pocket change.

name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
desc: Puppets dancing on water to live folk music — a thousand-year-old art for cheap-seat money.

name: Dong Xuan Market
desc: The Old Quarter's mothership market. Come for the fabric mountains, stay for the food alley out back.

name: Long Bien Bridge
desc: A century-old iron bridge over the Red River. Walk it at dawn as trains rattle past banana groves below.
